title: Grand Blue Season 3

thread.title: Grand Blue Dreaming Season 3 • Grand Blue Season 3 - Episode 12 discussion - FINAL

opinions.point: Many commenters found the episode extremely funny and praised its chaotic comic timing.
Several enjoyed the character interactions, especially the unlikely comedic partnership between Aina and Kohei.
The finale’s dramatic final beat generated strong excitement and anticipation for the next season.
Commenters generally felt the season was enjoyable overall and were pleased that another season was announced.
Some viewers were frustrated by the abrupt cliffhanger and wanted immediate resolution.
The episode’s balance of comedy, romance, and diving was appreciated, though some felt the ending was deliberately frustrating.
